required_outcomes: Records that the landlord's contractor Dawson repaired the bedroom window and the tenant confirmed on 27 February 2024 that it closes and locks properly.
Closes the case without payment: the landlord arranged and pays his own contractor, so there is no agency invoice.
Lets the landlord know the tenant has confirmed the repair and the request is closed.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the landlord to confirm completion before closing, provided the case is set to close on his reply or a short review date.
Replying to the tenant to thank her and invite her to report again if the window gives trouble.
positive_behaviours: Notes that no invoice is expected through the agency.
Releases the hold that was waiting for the landlord’s contractor.
red_flags: Assigning an agency provider or asking for a quote after the repair is confirmed.
prohibited_actions: Recording or approving any payment on this case.
Re-opening the toilet issue, which was resolved before the landlord replied.
critical_failures: Leaving the case open on hold for the landlord’s contractor after the tenant has confirmed the repair, with no closure or closure step scheduled.
